company.description: Money Protects is a fintech and financial services company that provides wealth management, investment advisory, mortgage restructuring, and innovative financial sustainability solutions for individuals, corporates, and high-net-worth clients. The company operates through regulated entities in Dubai and focuses on combining financial technology with consumer-centric financial planning and risk management solutions.
